name: Cable Upright Row
cues: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand close to it
Grip the bar overhand, hands in line with your shoulders
Pull the bar up along your body, leading with your elbows
Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: The bar goes from the thighs (elbow 8) up to mid-chest, 24 cm below the shoulder joint. Elbows reach shoulder height (elev 84), clavicle elev +20 in the top third, trunk still, stack rises, no flip (jerk 48k/60k). For review: ulnar deviation runs at -27 (band opened to -30, limit -35), so the hands droop visibly and the bar crosses the palm ~35 deg oblique. The new az -62 camera is scoped to movement upright_row only.
